'''Levardio''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Staff Sergeant/Legends|Staff Sergeant]] and a [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce Trooper]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Staff Sergeant Levardio was stationed in the rebel outpost [[Zephyr Base]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], where he offered weapons and armor to Rebels who served valiantly in battle.

==Behind the scenes==
Levardio is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was added to the game in Game Update 10 as part of the new Player versus Player Battlefields. He offers a variety of weapons and armor to Rebel players who fight consistently on the battlefields.
